records.name: park
records.tagline: Pause a process and free its TCP port. Resume later.
records.description: Freeze a running server and free its TCP port — without killing it. Resume later with the same PID, memory, and state. park reaches inside the target process and injects close(fd) via ptrace (Linux) or Mach thread injection (macOS) to release the listening socket. Resume recreates the listener at the same fd number. Works with uvicorn, FastAPI, Flask, python http.server, and more. Single binary, no deps. Choose an icon and keep designing - Ulticon takes care of everything else. Zero setup: all the power of components, no manual work. Zero frustration: custom icon overrides are always preserved. Zero guesswork: file-wide default symbol variant & color settings for your whole team.

records.name: No fluff. Just growth.
records.tagline: Marketing insights, simplified. No fluff. Just growth.
records.description: ClipDrift was born from a simple frustration: too much marketing noise, not enough clarity. After my first launch, I stepped back, rethought everything, and rebuilt it from scratch. ClipDrift is a curated newsletter for founders and marketers who want actionable insights, not fluff. Each edition delivers clear, practical ideas you can apply fast. No long essays. No generic tips. Just focused content to help you grow.

records.name: Inside the Token Tumbler
records.tagline: The visual guide to understanding how ChatGPT actually works
records.description: ChatGPT seems like magic. It's not. But explaining how it actually works requires wading through papers, math, and jargon most people don't have time for. "Inside the Token Tumbler" changes that. It's an interactive visual guide that walks you from raw data → tokens → neural networks → reasoning models in 20 minutes. Finally understand: How chain-of-thought prompting grants models more compute time or What makes DeepSeek-R1 different (emergent reasoning from RL alone) and more..

records.name: Cycla
records.tagline: Adaptive fitness that learns your cycle and conditions
records.description: Cycla is the first adaptive fitness app that treats hormonal conditions as a design system variable. It doesn't just know your cycle phase it learns YOUR energy patterns across PCOS, endometriosis, perimenopause, and 6+ conditions. After 2-3 cycles, it adapts to you specifically.

records.name: Tene
records.tagline: Your .env is not a secret. Tene hides it from AI agents.
records.description: Every AI coding agent — Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf — reads your entire project directory, includingenv files. Your API keys and database passwords are sent to AI models as plaintext. Tene is an open-source CLI that encrypts secrets locally and injects them as environment variables at runtime. AI agents can use your secrets without ever seeing them.

records.name: [epos] Web Extension Engine
records.tagline: A browser extension for building browser extensions
records.description: Epos is an opinionated engine for building Chromium browser extensions with React. While frameworks like WXT and Plasmo prioritize flexibility, Epos focuses on a zero-config experience with powerful features that work out of the box. At a high level, Epos gives you: - A cross-context messaging system - Shared state with persistence and sync - Storage for files and data - Extension APIs available in any context - Automatic script injection + Shadow DOM - A simpler setup through epos.json

records.name: ClimbUp - Stair Counter

records.description: ClimbUp turns flights climbed already recorded in Apple Health into a calm journey from sea level to Voyager 1. See today's floors, your next destination and ETA, start a live stair workout on iPhone or Apple Watch, earn 20 milestone patches, and optionally climb with friends. Raw HealthKit samples stay on device.

records.name: FramIQ
records.tagline: Professional grade bike fitting, now in your pocket.

Get instant notifications, AI-powered replies, and auto-engage before your competitors.

Open source.

records.name: DocMason

It cross-references your slides, buried tables, and multimodal elements like flowcharts or architecture diagrams. Instantly spot contradictions or connect dots across files. You get verifiable answers with exact source citations. Zero coding required. Turn your scattered working office files into a connected knowledge base today.

records.name: S.U.N.D.A.Y

records.name: Secure File Transfer

Chrome extension included for one-click sharing from desktop.

records.name: SearchHive
records.tagline: Web Search and Scraping for AI Agents
records.description: Enterprise web scraping APIs for modern developers. Search, scrape, and research the web with AI-powered tools. SwiftSearch, ScrapeForge, and DeepDive APIs.

records.name: TabConnect
records.tagline: Share one browser tab. Your viewer installs nothing.

You start from the Chrome or Edge toolbar, pick one tab, and hand over a short code, a link or a QR code. They open it in any browser, desktop or mobile, and they are watching. Freeze the view, lock the room, cap viewers, chat, send files up to 25 MB, use a laser pointer or pass over remote control. Free, and it still connects on locked-down corporate networks.

records.name: Bhagwat Prapti Sandesh Darshan News

Carefully crafted by a 16 y/o solo indie developer.

records.name: Bayesian Labs

Customize your cards with personalized stats (like Joy or Chaos!), choose your pack size, and experience a real "pack-opening" with your family. We even included playable game rules! Perfect for milestones, gifts, and youth sports.

records.description: Duelo.gg gives Dota 2 players a reason to stay focused every game — not just win the match, but win the duel. Pick a challenge — Kill Race, GPM Duel, Net Worth, queue into any normal ranked game, and our system automatically validates the result via OpenDota/Steam API. No manual reporting. No disputes. Every game has a personal goal beyond the match — no more tilting, no more blaming teammates. Earn PTS, climb the leaderboard, and compete in weekly tournaments for real Dota 2 items.

records.name: Localview Tech
records.tagline: Empowering industries with AI-driven software and automation
records.description: Localview Tech is an AI-first engineering company serving clients in the USA, UK, Singapore, UAE, and India. We build custom AI agents, LLM-powered platforms, generative AI products, full-stack web and mobile apps, ERP systems, and SaaS platforms. Top-rated AI software company for startups, SMEs, and enterprises worldwide.

records.name: Hephaestus
records.tagline: Modular API testing engine for Postman — zero dependencies
records.description: Hephaestus is an open-source framework that replaces scattered pre/post-request scripts in Postman with a single, version-controlled engine. Each request contains only a small override config. The engine handles everything: 20+ assertion operators, snapshot regression, JSON Schema, OAuth2, secret masking, and retries. Ships with 10+ CLI tools: HTML reports, JUnit XML, run comparisons, watch mode, docs generator, and Docker support. Zero npm dependencies. MIT licensed.

records.name: Open Comet
records.tagline: The autonomous AI browser agent for deep research & tasks
records.description: Open Comet is a high-fidelity AI agent that lives in your browser’s sidepanel. Unlike basic assistants, it autonomously browses, researches, and executes multi-step workflows across any website. Built on a "Zero-Data" architecture, it keeps your history local while providing enterprise-grade reasoning. Features include high-fidelity execution guards, STORM-inspired research loops, and full support for both Cloud (BYOK) and Local (Ollama) models.

records.name: Specd
records.tagline: AI PRD Generator for Indie Hackers
records.description: Generate a scoped Product Requirements Document in 15 seconds. Specd enforces a 5-feature limit to stop scope creep before you write a single line of code. Stack-aware output: tell it you're using Next.js + Supabase and the PRD adapts. 6 export formats: Markdown, Cursor, Claude Code, ChatGPT, Windsurf, GitHub Issues. Supports 7 app types: Web, Mobile, CLI, Browser Extension, API, Landing Page, and DevOps / IaC. PRD history saved to private dashboard. Free tier gives you 3 PRDs per month.

records.name: Thot Leader Labs
records.tagline: gifts and apparel for the professional degenerate
records.description: Amanda Nielsen started her career in tech as an aspiring thought-leader. At the ripe age 20-something, she is now jaded and considers herself a thot leader instead. Thot Leader is a catch-all term for the diverse community of professional disruptors she calls her friends. Thot Leadership is her authentic and unapologetic take on life as a gen Z memestress, professional ✨girlboss✨, and certified baddie navigating the professional world.

records.name: Price Page
records.tagline: 50 AI models. One insane pricing page wall.
records.description: Scroll from $1 to $1,000,000 through real pricing pages scraped and rebuilt by AI. Every button charges real money. You're buying nothing.

records.name: AI Tool Insider
records.tagline: Stop overpaying for SaaS. AI does the deal hunting for you
records.description: AI Tool Insider is a fully automated deal-discovery engine powered by a multi-agent AI pipeline running 24/7. Our agents scan 500+ sources — Product Hunt, GitHub, Hacker News, and partner networks — every 4 hours to surface the best AI and SaaS tools at the lowest verified prices. No manual curation. No stale deals. Every listing has been tested, price-checked, and validated before it goes live. When a deal expires, it gets pulled automatically. When a better price exists, we find it.

records.name: NeverMiss
records.tagline: AI call answering for home service businesses
records.description: NeverMiss builds custom automation systems for HVAC plumbing and roofing companies. The main product is an AI virtual receptionist that picks up calls 24/7 qualifies the caller and books jobs straight into the business calendar or CRM. It also handles missed call text back lead follow up and quote nurturing. Works with ServiceTitan Housecall Pro Jobber and GoHighLevel. Built for small to mid size home service businesses that are spending money on marketing but missing the calls it generates

records.name: Think. Prompt. Create
records.tagline: A practical guide to building software with Claude Code
records.description: Think. Prompt. Create. is a book for anyone who wants to go from idea to working software using AI. I wrote this from experience, years working in AI and product design at LinkedIn, building my own apps, and using Claude Code daily as my primary development tool. Whether you're a designer, founder, or someone who's never written a line of code, this book meets you where you are.

records.name: Windows Desktop Utilities Suite
records.tagline: 6 Windows apps with Rust, Tauri & React on MS Store
records.description: A suite of 6 Windows desktop apps published on the Microsoft Store under Illusanato. Built with Rust + Tauri + React + TypeScript for blazing fast, lightweight performance. Apps include WhySlowPC (system optimizer), and 5 more productivity utilities. All apps are native desktop experiences with minimal resource usage — no Electron bloat.

records.name: MoveScope
records.tagline: Move abroad with a plan, not a research spiral
records.description: MoveScope turns messy move-abroad research into a scenario-specific relocation brief. Compare destinations, run free planning tools, or order a tailored report covering topics like visa context, costs, healthcare, tax considerations, tradeoffs, sources, and next steps.
